definitions: Care taken to avoid danger or mistakes.
A warning against danger or error.
A person or thing that is a warning or an example to others.
A formal warning given by the police to someone who has committed a minor crime but is not charged.
examples: Exercise caution when using the machinery.
A word of caution about the new policy.
He is a caution, always getting into scrapes.
She received a police caution for shoplifting.
